name: Guangdong Tapai Group Co., Ltd.
summary: Guangdong Tapai Group Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the production and sale of cement in China. It offers Portland cement clinker; general purpose Portland cement clinker, such as Portland, ordinary Portland, pozzolanic Portland, slag Portland, fly ash Portland, and composite Portland cements; and ready-mixed concrete. The company sells its products under the Ta Pai, Yue Ta, Jiaying and Heng Ta brand names. Its products are used in infrastructure construction, including highways, hydropower projects, railways, ports, and airports, as well as various construction projects, such as real estate.
